source.note: v1 is a vitest + tree-sitter + Qdrant + Ollama project. Assertions are imported as observable behavior only. Vector-store payload schema (src/types.ts CodeChunkPayload/MemoryPayload, src/qdrant.ts collections/named vectors, specification.md schema), the colForType collection-name mapping, and old/new payload-shape assertions are intentionally NOT imported (01 §7).

families.name: parser
provenance: src/indexer/parser.ts (v1 parser exists, exercised only via the 49-query benchmark)

gaps.description: No v1 golden parser fixtures (source file -> expected units {kind, span, locator}) per language. The v0 language set is [OPEN] (O4). Parser unit goldens are authored once the language set is fixed.
Only skip-policy is present in v1. No full generation diff fixtures (tree A -> tree B -> expected files/occurrences added/removed/renamed + skips).
The 49-query corpus is single-relevant (one ground-truth target per query); no graded relevance judgments / multiple relevant docs. v2 gate thresholds (MRR regression budget, Recall@5) are TBD.

The rev6 labeled observation-stream corpus (transcript -> expected ops create|reinforce|supersede|noop, covering decision vs hypothesis vs negation, RU/EN mixed) is [FIXED, new in rev 6] and absent in v1. v1 store/dedup/scoring/router-extraction mechanics are imported; the op-quality corpus is not.

Prompt-injection round-trip-inert, delimiter-collision escaping and recall per-entry/per-block caps (14 §6, 12 §4) are v2-spec requirements absent in v1. Only router robustness against malformed LLM output is imported.

Executable failpoint/kill-point scripts for the F1-F12 projection matrix (05 §10) and S1-S8 spool matrix (07 §7) are not present in v1 (v1 has no crash/kill/torn-write tests). Only the declarative matrices and v1 retry/rate-limit behavior are imported; executable scripts need the fail_point!-style harness.
